(Japanese: アルカデスになる者 The One Who Would Become Arcades) is the 72nd chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Fraud easily defeats Rug and Karuta.
Fraud reveals that Gerubu is not a part of his plans and proceeds to kill him.
Ryouga finally succeeds in the caretaker's trial.
Fraud arrives to the Ryouga's location right when Ryouga is about to touch the statue.
